caption:

01. Delhi SIR Row: High-Profile Names, Cabinet Minister & Ex-Army Chief Under EC Scanner
02. Yu, 13, wins record-breaking first major gold medal

06. Man Enters Karnataka Home

08. Nepal flood toll crosses 1,450; over 6,000 still missing
